thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: paging-api: elevated 502/stream-reset errors from canary pool 'canary/paging-v1' starting 1887654300. Alert threshold breached (5m).
Alex (oncall): seeing it. paging endpoints returning chunked resets, errors spike ~30%.
Maria (eng-sre): can you paste the probe logs? I want connection reset patterns.
Alex (oncall): attaching excerpt: `ERR: stream reset, code=RST_STREAM(2) frame=0x10` repeated. Looks like HTTP/2 stream resets, client handshake ok.
DeployBot: Canary deploy initiating: canary/paging-v1 -> rollout id r-2026-03-15-09:12. 20% traffic.
Alex (oncall): @DeployBot did we roll a new SDK or runtime change in that canary?
DeployBot: Roll includes runtime change: kv-cache kernel upgrade + streaming socket pooling. Client SDK unchanged (v1.7 default).
Priya (runtime): I see a change in socket keepalive behavior in canary binary. Might be prematurely closing idle streams under high concurrent long-poll usage.
Liam (eng): Repro locally with synthetic load: open 1000 streaming connections, intermittent RSTs after ~30s.
Maria (eng-sre): impact assessment: ~12 customers hit errors on streaming paging requests; non-streaming paging OK. Severity: P1 for affected accounts.
Jordan (support): I have a live ticket from AcmeCorp complaining about list pagination failures in product search. Escalated.
Sam (pm): which customers are degraded? we need to notify enterprise customers ASAP.
Alex (oncall): Paging list: AcmeCorp, FinData, MediaHub — medium to high traffic. Not global outage but high impact for streaming clients.
Priya (runtime): Mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to previous runtime build; 2) flip feature flag to disable streaming socket pooling for canary hosts; 3) apply temporary proxy-level connection taper. Fastest is kill flag.
Maria (eng-sre): I can flip the FF. What's the flag name?
Priya (runtime): `ff/paging/stream-pool-v2` set to `off` for canary cluster.
Liam (eng): tested locally: turning flag off eliminates resets immediately under load.
Alex (oncall): Do it. Flip and confirm metrics.
Maria (eng-sre): running: `ffctl set ff/paging/stream-pool-v2 off --env=canary`
Maria (eng-sre): ✅ command returned 200. Rolling out to canary group.
Incident Bot: Feature flag change detected: ff/paging/stream-pool-v2 -> off by Maria.
Alex (oncall): watching metrics... errors dropping. 2m post-change error-rate down from 32% -> 3% for canary.
Jordan (support): replying to AcmeCorp: "We're investigating a streaming pagination regression related to a canary runtime change. We've applied a mitigation and are monitoring; will follow up with postmortem."
Sam (pm): Prepare customer note draft. Include rollback path and ETA for fix.
Priya (runtime): Root cause hypothesis: new keepalive behavior closes pooled sockets during long polling; servers then reject resumed streams leading to RSTs. Edge-case under long-lived streaming paging pattern.
Liam (eng): patch ready to alter keepalive threshold; will run canary build bake with the old keepalive setting. But that requires a new deploy.
Maria (eng-sre): Next steps decision: we keep FF off for canary and proceed with a hotfix build for canary test. If hotfix passes, promote. If not, full rollback.
Alex (oncall): Status page: please mark degraded for streaming paging in us-west for affected customers.
Jordan (support): Updating status page. Message: "Partial degradation impacting streaming pagination for some customers in us-west. Mitigation applied 1887654387 — reducing errors. Engineers investigating a permanent fix."
Sam (pm): Notify sales/CS for the three affected enterprise customers, advise support priority.
Priya (runtime): I'll run canary hotfix `r-2026-03-15-fix-keepalive`. ETA build and deploy ~18m.
Liam (eng): I'll coordinate smoke tests: `ab` style and internal replay harness.
Alex (oncall): On-call handoff at 1887654900 to Maria. I'll stay on thread for continuity.
Maria (eng-sre): Acknowledged handoff. Monitoring dashboards pinned.
Incident Bot: Pager note: on-call handoff logged: from Alex -> Maria at 1887654900.
Priya (runtime): Hotfix deployed to canary at 1887655120. Observability: no regressions on CPU/mem.
Liam (eng): Running replay harness now. Preliminary: streaming connections stable at 1k concurrent for 10m, no RSTs seen.
Maria (eng-sre): Post-hotfix metrics: error-rate for canary streaming down to 0.8%, request latency stable.
Alex (oncall): Great. Plan: keep FF off for 2h, then re-enable for a small subset to validate. If green, promote hotfix.
Jordan (support): Sent follow-up to customers with timeline and note that mitigation was applied and we're validating a fix.
Sam (pm): Requesting a short blameless postmortem: trigger owners: runtime (Priya), eng (Liam), SRE (Maria). Draft due EOD.
Priya (runtime): I'll own the bugfix PR and include regression test for long-held streaming sessions.
Liam (eng): Opening PR: #4829 - restore stable keepalive behavior + unit/integration tests.
Maria (eng-sre): Action items added to incident board: 1) Postmortem, 2) Add streaming e2e replay to CI, 3) Improve canary gating for connection-level metrics.
Alex (oncall): Closing actions for on-call: hand off to Maria, keep monitoring until FF re-enabled.
Incident Bot: Incident resolved for canary after mitigation and hotfix at 1887655210. Recording timeline and participants.
Alex (oncall): Thanks everyone. We'll sync in the postmortem channel for RCA and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
Jordan (support): I'll follow up with each customer tomorrow with details and apology.
Sam (pm): Adding customer impact to roadmap risks.
Priya (runtime): Note for postmortem: include the kernel/socket change, why unit tests missed it, and the new test coverage plan.
Liam (eng): Also recommend rate-limiting/burst tests for streaming scenarios in canary harness.
Maria (eng-sre): Logging action: capture more detailed stream reset counters and enable trace-level socket logs for next canary window.
Alex (oncall): Thread archived once postmortem doc published.
